paragraphs: Government Window provides payment technology to government agencies, pitched as covering every department in the agency and every type of payment those departments take in. The company sums up what it sells in four words, making payments simple and secure.

For residents, the arrangement is one web portal through which payments to the agency can be made easily. On the government side, staff can securely take payments in the office. The same customer portal is where staff run reports and reconcile the collections they have taken. The company presents this as one integrated set of payment solutions rather than a separate system for each department.
The site identifies the business as Government Window LLC. Beyond the payment product itself, the page says little about the company, its history, or the agencies it serves.
